name: Nancy Pearlman
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 4

items.text: Nancy Pearlman is an environmentalist and educator running for Seat 4 on the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees. She says she served on the board from 2001 to 2017 and taught at all nine of its colleges. She cites low enrollment as the biggest challenge and supports equal pay for part-time faculty, sustainable construction, and administrative accountability.
